name: talkopia
description: Talkopia - The Social Chess Platform with Video/Audio calls, Chat & Leaderboards

scripts.kill-port: powershell -Command "try { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } catch {}; exit 0"
scripts.predev: npm run kill-port || echo Port clear
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
